comingLast.roast: done and dusted on 23 - mostly dusted
averaging 0.7 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
at 1.4 a hole the blue balls fit like they were measured for him
3 holes between him and a very memorable presso
3 to play, 3 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
in the clubhouse, 1 point of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
finished 1 above the blue line - toasting every point Sutton does not score
finished with a 1-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
done and 1 above the drop - his interest in Sutton's round is intense and personal
2 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous
